earningsVs.subtitle: Imali yakho yangempela ye-DeHub uma iqhathaniswa nalokho okubukwa okufanayo obekuzokukhokha kwenye indawo.
earningsVs.estimatorLabel: Akuzona izinombolo zakho? Zama inani lokubukwa noma yiliphi
earningsVs.noteYoutube: Ngemva kwengxenye engu-45% ye-YouTube yemali yezikhangiso. Iyaguquguquka kakhulu ngokwesihloko nezwe lombukeli.
earningsVs.noteTwitch: Imali yezikhangiso kuphela — ayifaki ama-subs nama-bits, okuvamise ukuba yingxenye enkulu.
earningsVs.noteTiktok: I-Creator Rewards. Yaziwa ngokukhokha kancane ngokubukwa ngakunye; isilinganiso yiso sonke isimo.
earningsVs.noteReels: Izinhlelo zebhonasi zimemo kuphela futhi zivaliwe kaningi.
earningsVs.footnote: Izibalo zabancintisani ziyizilinganiso ezivela emikhakheni yemboni eshicilelwe, hhayi izinkokhelo ezikaliwe — i-RPM yangempela iyahluka kakhulu ngokwesihloko, izwe lababukeli nesikhathi sokubuka, ngakho hlela inani ngalinye ukuze lihambisane nalokho okuzuzayo ngempela. Inani le-DeHub yimali yakho yangempela yamathiphu eguqulwe ngentengo ye-DHB ebukhoma, futhi ayifaki okubhaliselwe, i-PPV noma ukuthengiswa kwesitolo. Ukubukwa kuhlanganiswe kokuthunyelwe kwakho okungu-100 kwakamuva.

solana.unavailableBody: Le divayisi ayiluphethe ukhiye wesikhwama sakho se-DeHub. Ngena futhi ukuze ubuyisele, nesikhwama sakho se-Solana sibuya naso.
solana.fundingBody: Ukuthumela, ukunikela nokuvula ku-Solana konke kukhokhelwa kusuka kuleli kheli. Thumela i-SOL kulo usuka ku-exchange noma kwesinye isikhwama — cishe i-0.01 SOL yanele okuthunyelwe okuningana. Litholakala esikhwameni sakho se-DeHub, ngakho libuya kunoma iyiphi idivayisi ongena kuyo.

solana.legacyBody: Inguqulo yangaphambili yohlelo yakha isikhwama se-Solana esehlukene esasikhona kule divayisi kuphela. Sisenemali. Dlulisela imali kwikheli elingenhla ngenkathi usenale foni — lowo khiye awukwazi ukutholakala kwenye indawo.

walletSetup.tryBiometricsHint: Sebenzisa lokhu uma usethe lesi sikhwama kule foni futhi ukhiye kufanele ukuthi usevele ulapha
walletSetup.restoreMissing: Isikhwama sale phrofayela asikho kule foni, ngakho akukho okungasayinwa okwamanje. Faka umushwana wokubuyisela noma ukhiye wangasese ukuze usilethe lapha.
walletSetup.writeThemDown: Bhala phansi endaweni ongafinyelela kuyo wena kuphela. Noma ubani onala magama unesikhwama sakho — usizo lwe-DeHub alukwazi ukuwabuyisa noma ukuwasetha kabusha.
walletSetup.noPhraseNoKey: Awunayo inkulumo futhi awunalo ukhiye? Lesi sikhwama singavulwa kuphela kudivayisi eyasakha — akukho lutho kuwebhusayithi noma ohlangothini lwethu olungasibuyisa. Ngena kuleyo divayisi uma usenayo.
walletSetup.resetExplainer: Lokhu kunika ukungena kwakho isikhwama esisha ngokuphelele, esingenalutho, futhi kudlulisele i-akhawunti yakho kuso. Akusivuli isikhwama esidala — le foni ayikwazi, i-dehub.io ayikwazi, nathi asikwazi — ngakho noma yini engaphakathi ihlala lapho.
walletSetup.checkingWaysBack: Sihlola ukuthi unayo enye indlela yokubuyela kulesi sikhwama…
walletSetup.couldNotCopy: Ayikwazanga ukukopisha — esikhundleni salokho bhala amagama phansi.
walletSetup.couldNotFinishSetup: Ayikwazanga ukuqeda ukusetha le akhawunti. Sicela uzame futhi.
walletSetup.securingWallet: Sivikela isikhwama sakho — kwamanye amadivayisi lokhu kungathatha kuze kufike kumzuzu owodwa…
walletSetup.unlockingWallet: Sivula isikhwama sakho — kwamanye amadivayisi lokhu kungathatha kuze kufike kumzuzu owodwa…
walletSetup.understandOldWalletA11y: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi isikhwama esidala, nanoma yini ekuso, ngeke kusatholakala
walletSetup.protectWallet: Ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi nguwe kuphela ongathumela noma athenge ngale akhawunti, vikela isikhwama sakho nge-biometrics yedivayisi yakho noma ngephasiwedi.
walletSetup.ifYouUsedDehub: Uma usuke wasebenzisa i-dehub.io ngaphambili, yivule kukhompyutha yakho, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangakhawunti efanayo, bese
walletSetup.biometricExplainer: Vula ngezigxivizo zeminwe noma ubuso bakho — akukho lutho okufanele ulubhale noma ulukhumbule. Ukhiye uhlala kule foni, ngakho sizokukhombisa inkulumo yokubuyisa yamagama angu-12 ozoyibhala phansi; yiyona kuphela indlela yokubuyela ngefoni ehlukile, ngewebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha. Khetha Iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho, bese iphasiwedi uqobo yenza lowo msebenzi.
walletSetup.biometricPrompt: Lesi sikhwama sivikelwa yi-biometrics yale divayisi. Qinisekisa ngesigxivizo somunwe noma ubuso ukuze uqhubeke.
walletSetup.enterRecoveryPhrase: Faka inkulumo yokubuyisa yamagama angu-12 owayigcina lapho udala lesi sikhwama (noma ukhiye waso oyimfihlo, uma wake wawukhipha). Ibuyela ku-akhawunti efanayo, futhi iphasiwedi oyisetha ngezansi iba yisipele esisebenza yonke indawo kusukela manje.
walletSetup.resetAndCreate: Setha kabusha bese wakha isikhwama esisha
walletSetup.thatsGoneToo: Nalokho kulahlekile — qala kabusha noma kunjalo
walletSetup.confirmStartOver: Qinisekisa ukuthi ufuna ukuqala kabusha ngesikhwama esisha
walletSetup.understandOldWallet: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi isikhwama esidala, nakho konke okukuso, ngeke ngisakwazi ukukuthola naphakade
walletSetup.savedTwelveWords: Sengiwagcinile la magama ayi-12 endaweni ephephile
walletSetup.legacyRecovered: Siqinisekise i-akhawunti yakho endala{{suffix}} futhi sabuyisa isikhwama sayo. Setha iphasiwedi ukuyivikela kule divayisi — kule foni nakuzo zonke ezinye izindawo, kusukela manje.
walletSetup.phraseExplainer: Isikhwama sakho sizovikelwa izinto zokubopha izigxivizo zale foni. Lokhu kuvula i-kusebenza kuphela kule foni — la mazwi angu-12 ayindlela kuphela yokubuyela uma ufake kabusha i-DeHub, ushintsha ifoni, noma ulahlekelwa yikho.
walletSetup.recoveryRecordNotice: Le akhawunti inerekhodi lokubuyisa recovery record kusuka ku-dehub.io. Ikhodi yokubuyisa yamagama angama-24 oyinikeziwe isavula leli walethi. Vula i-dehub.io kukhompyutha, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangaleyo akhawunti, bese usebenzisa leyo khodi — iletha iwalethi, ne-akhawunti yakho, njengoba zazinjalo.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeSingle: Le akhawunti inokuvulwa kwe-passkey okubhalisiwe ku-dehub.io. Esipheqululini esiyiphethe, i-dehub.io ingavula leli walethi.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeMultiple: Le akhawunti inokuvulwa kwe-passkey okungaphezu kokukodwa okubhalisiwe ku-dehub.io. Esipheqululini esiphethe noma yikuphi kuzo, i-dehub.io ingavula leli walethi.
walletSetup.otherWaysCheckFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unezinye izindlela zokubuyela kuleli walethi. Uma wake walungisa ikhodi yokubuyisa noma i-passkey ku-dehub.io, hamba uzame lokho kuqala — ukuqhubeka lapha kuzosula zona.
walletSetup.loseFundsBody: Izilinganiso zayo zihlala ku-{{address}}blockchain — akukho okuchithwayo noma okuthathwayo — kodwa ukuzihambisa kudinga umusho wokubuyisa waleyo walethi noma ukhiye oyimfihlo. Ngaphandle kwawo, akekho ongakwazi ukufinyelela kuwo: hhayi wena, hhayi thina. Ngaphandle kokuthi ukwazi ukukhipha ukhiye kudivayisi eyiwumbayo, phatha lokho okukuyo njengokulahlekile.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryBody: Irekodi lokubuyisa ku-dehub.io lisulwa njengengxenye yalokhu, ngakho-ke leyo ndlela nayo iyavalwa.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryUnknownBody: Uma wake walungisa ikhodi yokubuyisa yamagama angama-24 ku-dehub.io, iyasulwa njengengxenye yalokhu. Asikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unayo yini.
walletSetup.losePasskeysBody: Ama-passkey abhaliswe ku-dehub.io asuswa njengengxenye yalokhu.
walletSetup.losePasskeysUnknownBody: Noma yimaphi ama-passkey abhaliswe ku-dehub.io asuswa njengengxenye yalokhu. Asikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unayo yini.
walletSetup.keepAccountBody: Igama lomsebenzisi, iphrofayela, okuthunyelwe, ukuphawula, abalandeli, izindondo kanye nomlando konke kuyahamba kuye kule walethi entsha. Kuyi-akhawunti efanayo — akekho okudingeka akutholakale futhi.
walletSetup.keepMessagesBody: Izingxoxo, izaziso, izincwadi, okuthunyelwe okugciniwe nomlando wokubuka kuza nawe. Akukho lutho olusulwayo futhi akekho omunye ongakufunda.
walletSetup.keepSignInBody: Inombolo yocingo efanayo, i-imeyili noma i-akhawunti ye-Google, ukuthepha okukodwa okufanayo. Yileyo walethi engemuva kokungena esikhundleni, hhayi ukungena.
walletSetup.checkDeviceBody: Ifoni igcina ikhophi yayo yokhiye ngenkathi i-DeHub ifakiwe, futhi isiphequluli sigcina i-passkey yaso. Uma usenayo noma yikuphi, hamba lapho, thumela ukhiye oyimfihlo, bese ubuyela lapha bese usebenzisa i-Restore esikhundleni — lokho kugcina nezilinganiso.
walletSetup.passwordBreached: Le phasiwedi ivele ku-data breach — khetha enye ehlukile
walletSetup.phraseInvalidHint: Lokho akuhambisani njengephasiwedi yokubuyisa — amagama ayi-12, ngokulandelana kwawo, wonke angama-lowercase.
walletSetup.privateKeyHint: Ukhiye oyimfihlo ungama-64 wezinhlamvu ze-hex ngemuva kwe-0x.
walletSetup.noUsableBackup: Le akhawunti inekheli lewalethi elingefayeleni, kodwa ayikho isipele leli foni elingasisebenzisa — noma yavalwa nge-biometrics noma i-passkey kuwebhu (lokho kuvulwa kuhlala esipheqululini futhi akuhambisani lapha), noma ukubhalisa kwangaphambili kuleli foni kwaphazamiseka ngaphambi kokuba kuqedwe.
walletSetup.addPasswordOnWeb: Uma wake wazisebenzisa i-dehub.io ngaphambili, yivule kukhompyutha yakho, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangaleyo akhawunti, bese u-engeza iphasiwedi ye-wallet — lokho kugcina isipele esibethelwe efwini. Bese ubuyela lapha bese uzama futhi.
walletSetup.biometricKeepsFailing: {{error}} Uma lokhu kuqhubeka nokuhluleka, sebenzisa iphasiwedi yakho ye-wallet ngezansi noma u-"Ngenisa i-wallet yangaphandle".
walletSetup.deviceBoundKey: Le wallet ivulwa nge-biometrics egcinwe kudivayisi eyodwa ethize — ifoni noma isiphequluli lapho yasetshenziswa khona. Le foni ayinawo lowo okhiye, futhi ne-dehub.io ayinawo: okhiye abaphumi kudivayisi eyawenzayo.
walletSetup.unlockPasskeyOnly: Le wallet yavikelwa nge-passkey kuwebhu futhi ayikabi nayo isipele sephasiwedi efwini. Uma usetha iphasiwedi ye-wallet ku-dehub.io, uyifake lapha — kungenjalo sebenzisa i-Ngenisa i-wallet yangaphandle ngezansi.
walletSetup.unlockWithPasswordExplainer: Le akhawunti isivele inayo i-wallet, evikelwe ngephasiwedi. Yifake ukuze ubuyise i-wallet yakho kule divayisi.
